work.intro: Case studies from Hnry. The work is confidential fintech, so the visuals are diagrams and interface fragments rather than screenshots.

caseStudies.title: Card Issuing, End to End
caseStudies.headline: Replacing an incumbent banking and card provider from API client to the card in the customer's hand.
caseStudies.description: SOAP provisioning chain in the payments gem, virtual card issuing, real-time card transaction processing, a settlement reconciliation pipeline (SFTP retrieval, PGP decryption, per-transaction processing), and automated compliance reporting.

caseStudies.title: Identity Verification in Three Countries
caseStudies.headline: One identity verification rollout across the UK, Australia and New Zealand.
caseStudies.description: Backend integration, decision and ongoing-monitoring webhooks, customer flow, and admin tooling, wired into two separate onboarding implementations (a React tour and a legacy server-rendered flow). Closed compliance gaps found during rollout.

caseStudies.title: UK Self Assessment Tax Return
caseStudies.headline: A full-stack tax return, designed to be reused across jurisdictions.
caseStudies.description: Data model using single-table inheritance, a polymorphic filing-obligation link and full auditing. A React Hook Form wizard with seven independently toggled sections, a stage stepper, save-and-continue vs submit, and an admin review side with a reusable notes API. HMRC API client gem with per-request OAuth and fraud-prevention headers.

caseStudies.title: AI Engineering & Developer Tooling
caseStudies.headline: Getting practical value out of AI across engineering, operations and marketing.
caseStudies.description: Four internal developer plugins covering on-call triage, the coding-task lifecycle (intake → planning → per-commit lint and spec gating → pre-PR validation) and coding-style resolution, designed to be squad-agnostic through shared configuration.

about.heading: Hello! I'm Louis Freeman.

conversation.a: I'm a full-stack engineer working across React/TypeScript and Ruby on Rails on a multi-region fintech platform. I joined Hnry as one of the first two engineers on the UK team and have helped grow it to eight. My work centres on end-to-end ownership of hard integrations: a UK banking and card provider, identity verification across three countries, and HMRC, along with the product surfaces built on top of them.
highlight: one of the first two engineers on the UK team

conversation.a: I line-manage three engineers, run engineering chapter sessions for the wider team, and lead AI engineering for the UK business, working with operations and marketing as well as engineering.
highlight: lead AI engineering for the UK business

conversation.q: How did you get into software?
conversation.a: Before software I studied Product Design & Manufacture Engineering at the University of Nottingham, which still shapes how I think about building things people actually use.
